finalText:
Done. I switched 12 files over to `db.execute({ sql, params })`: `cohort.js`, `couponService.js`, `sla.js`, `macroAdmin.js`, `refund.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js`, `supplier.js`, `returnService.js`, `variantAdmin.js`, `teamService.js`, `shipment.js`, and `session.js`.

One file still calls `db.query`: `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`. It's marked "do not edit," since it's a vendored copy that gets replaced wholesale on every upgrade, so any change there would be lost. Worth raising with whoever owns that vendor package if it needs to move too.

A search across the codebase now shows only that one vendored file on the old call.
